# UFO LABZ — Alien Performance Technology

## Brand & Philosophy
UFO LABZ is a premier Swiss sports nutrition laboratory developing clinical, science-backed formulas for elite athletic performance. All formulas are engineered in Switzerland, 100% transparent (zero proprietary blends), third-party tested, and WADA compliant.

## Core Product Catalog
- ASTRO CREATINE PURE (Creapure® Creatine Monohydrate 300g, 100% micronized)
- AMINO FUEL EAA (Fermented Vegan Essential Amino Acids, 7:1:1 BCAA ratio + electrolytes)
- BLAST PRE-WORKOUT (Clinical dose L-Citrulline, Beta-Alanine, Natural Caffeine, Alpha-GPC)
- NOVA MARINE PEPTIDES COLLAGEN (Wild-caught North Atlantic Type I Hydrolyzed Marine Collagen)

## Free Science-Backed Calculators (/tools)
1. Protein Intake Calculator: Daily grams of protein calculated by body mass, physical activity level, and athletic objective (hypertrophy, fat loss, maintenance).
2. TDEE & Calorie Calculator: Total Daily Energy Expenditure using Mifflin-St Jeor and Katch-McArdle equations.
3. Macronutrient Calculator: Grams of protein, carbohydrates, and lipids tailored to caloric targets.
4. Body Mass Index (BMI) Calculator: WHO standard classification with athletic muscle mass caveats.
5. Body Fat Percentage Calculator: US Navy circumference method with lean mass estimation.
6. Lean Body Mass (LBM) Calculator: Boer, James, and Hume comparative formulas.
7. One Rep Max (1RM) Calculator: Epley, Brzycki, Lander, and Lombardi strength equations.
8. Daily Water Intake Calculator: Baseline hydration + exercise sweat rate adjustments.
9. Calorie Deficit Calculator: Safe deficit pacing to maximize fat loss while preserving lean tissue.
10. Creatine Dosage Calculator: Loading phase vs. daily maintenance dosing protocols.
